capture-ingestion.description: Capturing developer activity from shells, agent sessions, browsers or filesystem watchers. Excludes generic database ingestion without activity capture.
inclusions: Capturing developer activity from shells, agent sessions, browsers or filesystem watchers. Excludes generic database ingestion without activity capture.
positive_examples: Implement a shell hook and filesystem session watcher.

knowledge-retrieval.description: Searching or retrieving knowledge, relevance ranking, embeddings, vector search, RAG or knowledge graphs. Merely calling a search tool is insufficient.
inclusions: Searching or retrieving knowledge, relevance ranking, embeddings, vector search, RAG or knowledge graphs. Merely calling a search tool is insufficient.
exclusions: A search tool mentioned in a deployment log.
positive_examples: Evaluate hybrid knowledge search and relevance reranking.
hard_negatives: A search tool mentioned in a deployment log.

database-storage.description: Database schemas, SQL, persistence, transactions, indexes or storage consistency.
inclusions: Database schemas, SQL, persistence, transactions, indexes or storage consistency.
exclusions: A database product named in a UI screenshot.
positive_examples: Fix SQLite transaction isolation and add a database index.
hard_negatives: A database product named in a UI screenshot.

observability.description: Logging, metrics, tracing, health checks, alarms or monitoring as a substantive subject.
inclusions: Logging, metrics, tracing, health checks, alarms or monitoring as a substantive subject.
positive_examples: Instrument tracing spans and an alarm on queue latency.

testing-validation.description: Testing software correctness, regression checks, validation or evaluation methodology. A passing test mentioned in an unrelated change is insufficient.
inclusions: Testing software correctness, regression checks, validation or evaluation methodology. A passing test mentioned in an unrelated change is insufficient.
exclusions: Tests passed after changing a README.
positive_examples: Design a regression suite and an evaluation rubric.
hard_negatives: Tests passed after changing a README.

performance-optimization.description: Improving or measuring runtime latency, throughput, memory, compute consumption, caching or profiling.
inclusions: Improving or measuring runtime latency, throughput, memory, compute consumption, caching or profiling.
exclusions: A fast response without performance work.
positive_examples: Profile allocations and reduce query p95 latency.
hard_negatives: A fast response without performance work.

security-access.description: Authentication, authorization, credentials, vulnerabilities, privacy or secret handling.
inclusions: Authentication, authorization, credentials, vulnerabilities, privacy or secret handling.
exclusions: A secret mentioned as a variable name.
positive_examples: Rotate credentials and test authorization boundaries.
hard_negatives: A secret mentioned as a variable name.

deployment-operations.description: Deploying, releasing, configuring or operating running applications, services or infrastructure.
inclusions: Deploying, releasing, configuring or operating running applications, services or infrastructure.
positive_examples: Deploy a service and diagnose its launchd lifecycle.

build-dependencies.description: Build systems, compilers, toolchains, package management or dependency version changes.
inclusions: Build systems, compilers, toolchains, package management or dependency version changes.
positive_examples: Pin dependency versions and fix compiler compatibility.

source-control.description: Version-control workflows, commits, branches, merging or pull-request mechanics. Merely naming a branch or commit is insufficient.
inclusions: Version-control workflows, commits, branches, merging or pull-request mechanics. Merely naming a branch or commit is insufficient.
exclusions: A branch name appears in a test result.
positive_examples: Resolve a merge conflict and restructure stacked pull requests.
hard_negatives: A branch name appears in a test result.

code-structure.description: Software architecture, API contracts, module boundaries, data models, type design or refactoring as a substantive subject.
inclusions: Software architecture, API contracts, module boundaries, data models, type design or refactoring as a substantive subject.
exclusions: An HTTP call without API design work.
positive_examples: Refactor module boundaries and define a typed API contract.
hard_negatives: An HTTP call without API design work.

ui-interaction.description: User interfaces, interaction design, visual layout, accessibility, forms or navigation.
inclusions: User interfaces, interaction design, visual layout, accessibility, forms or navigation.
exclusions: Use an interface in a command example.
positive_examples: Improve form navigation and keyboard accessibility.
hard_negatives: Use an interface in a command example.

documentation-learning.description: Authoring, repairing or learning from documentation, guides or tutorials as the main activity. Merely citing documentation is insufficient.
inclusions: Authoring, repairing or learning from documentation, guides or tutorials as the main activity. Merely citing documentation is insufficient.
exclusions: Read API documentation while fixing storage.
positive_examples: Write an operator guide and repair its examples.
hard_negatives: Read API documentation while fixing storage.

networking-protocols.description: Network transport, HTTP behavior, DNS, sockets, routing or communication protocols. Merely calling an API is insufficient.
inclusions: Network transport, HTTP behavior, DNS, sockets, routing or communication protocols. Merely calling an API is insufficient.
exclusions: Call an HTTP API to classify a document.
positive_examples: Diagnose DNS resolution and HTTP timeout behavior.
hard_negatives: Call an HTTP API to classify a document.
